title: Principal LLM binding update
description: Body of PUT /v1/me/llm/{role}: choose a catalog profile and optional model (ADR 0041). Optional voice and language for speech roles (ADR 0043). The role is the path.

model_id.description: Required when the catalog entry lists several models; otherwise must match the entry's model_id or be omitted.

voice.description: Provider voice id for role tts. Ignored for other roles.

language.description: BCP 47 language for role tts or stt. Ignored for other roles.
